header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
(Mehar and others v/s. Province of Sindh & Ors)
Petitioner: Through Mr. Kanji Mal Meghwar, Advocate
body: 1. Through instant Petition, the Petitioners claim the benefit of upgradation of post, granted to the para medical staff of Local Government Department Government of Sindh vide notification dated 14.12.2010 issued by the Secretary Local Government Department. The Petitioners claim that an identical constitution petition No D 414 of 2015 (Re Ahmed V. M.C. Tando Adam and others) was allowed by the Learned Division Bench of this Court at Hyderabad vide judgment dated 16.102025. Learned Counsel for the Petitioner claims simialr treatment for the Petitioners.

2. Learned Additional Advocate General, filed reply of Secretary Finance and submits that the issue of the upgradation is purely an internal affair of the department and required adjudication at the departmental level for scrutiny and appropriate orders. He concedes that if the Petitioners are found entitled for upgradation, their claim shall be entertained in accordance with law and rules. Learned Counsel for the Petitioner is satisfied on the statement made at bar and seeks disposal of the petition.

3. In view of above, this petition is disposed of. The Respondents are directed to scrutinize the case of Petitioners at departmental and if they are found entitled for the benefit of notification dated 14.12.2010 and judgment passed in the case of Ahmed (Supra), they shall be granted such benefits. The department shall complete this exercise within a period of 3 months’ time from date of this order.
4. Office is directed to send copy of this Order to the Respondents for compliance.
